The Roots: From Traditional Craftsmanship to Digital Innovation

The story of AZ-Europa Service began with a clear observation: The facility management industry was increasingly plagued by price dumping, untrained personnel, and short-term thinking. The exceptional quality that once made German trades worldwide renowned seemed to be fading in the service sector.

We chose to take a different path. Our corporate philosophy is based on a return to the "Meisterbrief" (the German Master Craftsman Certificate). It proves that we have mastered our trade from the ground up—whether in complex commercial cleaning, highly sensitive renovation work, or technical facility management.

Today, we manage our fleets in Nuremberg, coordinate our renovation teams in Erlangen, and monitor cleaning protocols in Bamberg using fully digital, cloud-based systems. Many view commercial cleaning or janitorial services merely as the removal of dirt or the fixing of immediate flaws. We see it completely differently. Our central promise to our clients can be summed up in one German concept: Werterhalt (Long-term Asset Value Preservation).

Commercial properties are massive capital investments. The wrong cleaning chemicals can ruin expensive natural stone floors in a matter of months. Amateur repairs can jeopardize the energy efficiency of an entire building. Our master-level approach guarantees that every action we take—from the daily wipe-down to major facade renovations—is scientifically designed to protect the building's fabric and secure, or even increase, the financial value of your property over the long term. That is our uncompromising quality promise.
Our Values: Precision, Reliability, and Discretion
To meet our own demanding standards, we have defined three core values that are internalized by every employee at AZ-Europa Service GmbH:

Precision: We leave absolutely nothing to chance. Whether it is the exact dosing of eco-friendly cleaning agents or the millimeter-precise installation of new flooring—our work is measurably exact. We operate according to strict DIN norms and the highest health guidelines.
Reliability: A handshake is binding for us. When we guarantee a 2-hour response time in the Franconian region, we keep that promise. Our clients know they can rely on us 100%, 365 days a year.

Discretion: We frequently operate in highly sensitive environments—from executive boardrooms and law firms to medical practices and research laboratories. Our staff is not only technically trained but also educated in absolute confidentiality and unobtrusive workflows. We are the invisible force that keeps your business running smoothly.

A "Meisterbetrieb" (Master Business) is only ever as good as its team. At AZ-Europa Service, we do not believe in utilizing untrained day laborers or anonymous subcontractors. We rely on permanently employed, continuously trained specialists.

datenschutz.desc: For AZ-Europa Service GmbH, protecting your personal data is not just a legal obligation, but a core component of our commitment to quality and digital trust. In this Privacy Policy, we inform you comprehensively and transparently about how we handle your personal data when you visit our website or use our facility management services.
paragraphs: **General Information**

The following notes provide a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data with which you could be personally identified. Detailed information on the subject of data protection can be found in our Privacy Policy below.
**Data Collection on this Website**
Who is responsible for the data collection on this website?
The data processing on this website is carried out by the website operator. You can find their contact details in the "Legal Notice" (Impressum) of this website.
How do we collect your data?

Some data is collected when you provide it to us. This could, for example, be data you enter into a contact form. Other data is collected automatically by our IT systems when you visit the website. This data is primarily technical data (e.g., the browser and operating system you are using or the time the page was accessed).
What do we use your data for?
Part of the data is collected to ensure the error-free provision of the website. Data from contact forms is used exclusively to process your service requests and provide you with business quotes.
**Data Protection**

The operators of this website take the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data as confidential and in accordance with the statutory data protection regulations (GDPR/DSGVO) and this Privacy Policy.
**Responsible Party (Controller)**
**The responsible party for data processing on this website is:**
**AZ-Europa Service GmbH**
**Phone: [Your Phone Number]**
**Email: info@az-europaservice.de**
**Revocation of your Consent to Data Processing**

Many data processing operations are only possible with your express consent. You can revoke your consent at any time. The legality of the data processing carried out before the revocation remains unaffected.
**Your User Rights under the GDPR**
**Under applicable legal provisions, you have the right at any time to:**
Right of Access (Art. 15 GDPR): Request information about your stored personal data, its origin, recipients, and the purpose of data processing.
Right to Rectification (Art. 16 GDPR): Demand the correction of incorrect or incomplete data.
Right to Erasure (Art. 17 GDPR): Request the deletion of your data stored by us ("Right to be forgotten").
Right to Restriction of Processing (Art. 18 GDPR): Request the restriction of processing of your personal data.

Right to Data Portability (Art. 20 GDPR): Have data that we process automatically based on your consent or in fulfillment of a contract handed over to you or to a third party in a standard, machine-readable format.
To exercise these rights, please contact us at the address provided in the Legal Notice. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.
**SSL or TLS Encryption**

For security reasons and to protect the transmission of confidential content, such as inquiries you send to us, this site uses SSL or TLS encryption. You can recognize an encrypted connection by the fact that the address line of the browser changes from "http://" to "https://" and by the lock symbol in your browser line.
**Cookies**

Our website uses so-called "cookies". Cookies are small text files that do not cause any damage to your device. They are either stored temporarily for the duration of a session (session cookies) or permanently (permanent cookies).

Technically Necessary Cookies: Cookies that are required to carry out the electronic communication process or to provide certain functions you require are stored on the basis of Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. We have a legitimate interest in storing cookies for the technically error-free and optimized provision of our services.

Consent-based Cookies: If other cookies (e.g., for analyzing your surfing behavior) are stored, we require your explicit consent (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR). You can manage these via our Cookie Consent Banner.
**Server Log Files**
The provider of the pages automatically collects and stores information in so-called server log files, which your browser automatically transmits to us. These are:
**Browser type and version**
**Operating system used**
**Referrer URL**
**Hostname of the accessing computer**
**Time of the server request**
**IP address**
These data are not merged with other data sources. This data is recorded on the basis of Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.
**Contact Form and Email Inquiries**

If you send us inquiries via the contact form, email, or telephone, your details, including the contact details you provided, will be stored by us for the purpose of processing the inquiry and in case of follow-up questions. The processing of this data is based on Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR, provided your request is related to the execution of a contract or is necessary to carry out pre-contractual measures (e.g., creating a facility management quote).

The data you enter in the contact form will remain with us until you ask us to delete it, revoke your consent to store it, or the purpose for data storage no longer applies. Mandatory statutory provisions—in particular retention periods—remain unaffected.
